lead: George Michael was a British singer-songwriter, born on 25 June 1963 in East Finchley.
He died on 25 December 2016 in Goring-on-Thames at the age of 53.
He is associated with work such as Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go, Faith and Careless Whisper and has been recognised with BRIT Awards and BRIT Awards.

sections.heading: George Michael — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: George Michael was born on 25 June 1963 in East Finchley, and holds British nationality. He was given the name Georgios Kyriacos Panayiotou at birth and is publicly known as George Michael.
Public records name his father, Kyriacos Panayiotou and his mother, Lezli Angold Panayiotou. He is a sibling of Melanie Panayiotou and Yioda Panayiotou.
His listed education includes Bushey Meads School and Kingsbury High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: George Michael — Career and Professional Work
paras: George Michael works primarily as a singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, record producer, singer, songwriter and lyricist.
Among the credits most often linked to George are Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go, Faith, Careless Whisper, Last Christmas, I Want Your Sex and Father Figure.
